response.sql: SELECT AVG(item_avg_ratio) AS overall_average_ratio, AVG(invoice_line_item_count) AS average_invoice_line_items_per_order_item FROM (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS item_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS invoice_line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) AS per_item
